en: Sepia-toned postcard showing a rocky marble quarry beside a road carved into a cliff. Several men in traditional clothing lead pack animals (likely donkeys or mules) along the road. The scene is mountainous, with rough rock faces on the left and open landscape to the right. Below the image there is printed multilingual caption text explaining that the marble used for the road is extracted and worked on site. A website watermark 'www.elia.org.gr' appears over the lower right part of the image.
